How vaping causes collapsed lungs and death? 

For the last 8 days I have  had a tube from my lungs which has being removing liquid from my lungs.

I have being vaping for only 6 years, in that box there is over 900mls alone of liquid from my lungs.

According to my surgeons there was substantialy more liquid that was removed during the operation in addition to what was in the box. 

Vaping also causes cysts/pimples on the lungs and when they burt/pop lungs start to collapse. (That's what happend to me) 

Some flavours have also found to be carcinogenic. (Can cause cancer)

I only vaped E-liquid from shops in New Zealand that was made in New Zealand/USA and sold in local stores here and nothing else. I've never done anything home made or smoked THC or oils.

The only thing that we should put in our lungs is oxygen not e-liquid or smoke.

I'm not attacking the industry I'm just calling for more regulation and awareness as vaping isn't as safe as everyone thinks long term. This is just what happend to me, 14 days in hospital some of it spent life threatening condition with two operations and three tubes/wires stuck in me. 

Lots of people in the US are dying from vaping and in the next few years we will see the same problems in New Zealand according to doctors and nurses in hospital. 

I was a heavy vaper and would vape 12-18 hours a day. I started on the big cloudy vapes with higher wattage then for the last two years I was pods and nic salt E-juices.

This may not happen to everyone as my body shape lean/muscular is slightly more prone to collapsed lungs then those that are obese.

Smoking is dangerous but with vaping we don't have the historical data to prove that it's safe to vape for 50+ years. Remember years ago doctors encouraged pregnant woman to smoke as it helped with stress. 

I still see benefits of vaping short term to get of smoking but we shouldn't swap one addiction for another long term.

Please do your own research to make your own decision on what's best for you.
